sources.use_in_phase: Preserve sandbox, approval, and local-workflow boundaries for CLI lanes and x2 build sessions.
Model the waiting-session policy as low-risk autonomous work with explicit boundaries and authorization checks.
Keep connector and app-server token/audience boundaries explicit; do not publish raw transport or credentials.
Treat skill manifests, command runners, and helper workflows as execution-layer security surfaces.
Shape future skill/command cleanup into scoped credential, provenance, review, and least-privilege checks.
Use explicit isolation and runtime-observability principles as analogies for local watcher and sandbox readiness.

x2_security_tasks: Add no-overclaim validation for GMUT/canon closure language.
Add a scoped skill-inventory receipt helper before any skill cleanup packet.
Add an MCP connector-boundary receipt for app-server and connector use.
Add a watcher/no-poll proof receipt for scheduled waiting windows.
Add a command-risk summary receipt that flags critical and high-risk command counts before x2 builds.
